scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @hubmi/web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.setup:api: cd apps/api && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:api:dev: cd apps/api && (.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt || uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements-dev.txt)
